publication_scope: Publish already-completed review and existing offline evidence only; no new test execution or mechanical re-review.
conclusion_zh: 复审收口：离线修复范围内未发现新的可证实阻塞项，可以合并；依用户要求仍保持草稿，不执行合并或部署。

limits: Public readers without originals cannot independently prove redaction derivation; local originals checked here.
No claim of hostile concurrent directory replacement resistance.

verification_procedure: Check distinct identities and complete historical status chains against both original and public matrices.
Verify each receipt SHA256, exact test ID, terminal status and cited line; check embedded four-test log.
Check three original/public hash mappings and line counts; retained originals checked locally.
Invoke pinned entry blob for same/child/ancestor/dotdot/existing-output cases; require nonzero exit and unchanged source/existing bytes.
Compare 60 registered frozen asset hashes; verify five pinned remote Git blobs against local checked evidence.
evidence_representation: Embedded result and remote bindings retain parsed original content. SHA256 values refer to original local file bytes, not reserialized embedded objects. Private originals and verifier retained locally; no raw diagnostic publication.
remaining_limits_zh: 1319为累计逐项证据汇总，不是本次全仓或全仓Linux重跑。
公开投影可核测试身份、状态、引用行号与文件哈希；没有原件的第三方无法独立证明删减诊断的内容或推导过程。
不承诺抵抗恶意并发替换目录。
未新增生产自然调度、真实云端上传回读或物理容量极值验收。
change_boundary: Audit record only; no frozen model, protocol, history, workflow, production task or trigger changes.
closure_policy_zh: 本次为最终收口记录；仅代码变化、新测试失败或新实质证据才重新打开审查。文档收口提交本身不触发机械复审。
